description: Set how much is still expected on a budget line (expected remaining), which drives its forecast, or clear it with null so TourPro suggests planned minus actual again. The amount is in the line's own currency. Get lineId and rowVersion from get_tour_budget. Requires Manage finance and tour-wide access.

anyOf.description: Expected remaining amount as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

expectedRemaining.description: Expected remaining amount as a decimal string in the line currency, e.g. "2500" or "2.500,00"; null clears it.

rowVersion.description: The line rowVersion from get_tour_budget; refused if it changed since.

name: update_budget_line_remaining
title: Update budget line expected remaining
